summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Lion Céleste - ConsultationSection form and ProductDetail 360° viewer features. All 16 features from review request verified and passing.
critical_code_review_comments: React accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' in ProductDetail - was also present in iteration_1 (minor accessibility issue, not functional)

In ConsultationSection handleChange, two setState calls are made when field='product': first sets the field, then immediately overwrites with size reset. Should be merged into one setState call to avoid potential double-render. Functionally correct but not optimal.
Schmuckstück field label is not marked as required (*) in the UI despite being useful for complete consultation - minor UX note only
test_credentials: N/A - Frontend only prototype, no auth
mocked_apis: MOCKED: Form submission uses 1.2s setTimeout, no actual API call. Success state rendered after timeout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 new features tested and passing. Products data: id=1 (rings - Les Ailes d'Ange), id=2 (necklaces - Collier Infini coeur), id=3 (rings - Anneau du démon), id=4 (bracelets - Bracelet de l'infini). data-testids all correct. On first bracelet selection attempt the click failed due to animation timing, but second attempt (with 500ms wait) worked fine.
